educrm.tagline: CRM platform for educational centers that centralizes academic management, scheduling, finances and analytics.
educrm.description: EduCRM is a production CRM platform built for educational centers. It centralizes student management, academic operations, scheduling, payments, finances and analytics in one system. The platform is used by real education centers and operates as a subscription-based product.
educrm.problem: Educational centers struggle to manage students, groups, schedules, attendance, academic performance, and finances using disconnected spreadsheets and generic tools. This leads to administrative overhead, lost revenue, and poor communication with parents.
educrm.solution: EduCRM centralizes all academy operations into a single, cohesive platform. It automates routine tasks, provides real-time financial oversight, and offers a dedicated portal for academic tracking, allowing centers to focus on education rather than administration.
educrm.galleryDesc: Explore the core interfaces and user experience.
educrm.techDesc: Selected for performance, scalability, and maintainability to support production loads across multiple active academies.

ilmOmuz.tagline: An educational platform where students can learn, take courses, read lessons, solve programming tasks and complete quizzes in one environment.
ilmOmuz.description: ILM OMUZ is an educational platform designed to bring learning, practice and AI assistance into a single environment. Students can join learning groups, study structured course materials, read lectures, complete quizzes and solve programming tasks. The platform also includes Omuz AI — an AI learning assistant powered by OpenAI models. Students can communicate with the assistant through regular chat, voice interaction and Live Mode. A persistent AI mascot is also available throughout the platform to provide contextual help when needed.
ilmOmuz.galleryDesc: Explore the core interfaces and user experience.
ilmOmuz.techDesc: Selected for performance, scalability, and seamless AI integration.
ilmOmuz.omuzAiDesc: A key differentiator of Ilm_Omuz is the deeply integrated AI learning assistant. Designed to support educational conversations and answer questions contextually, Omuz AI provides interactive guidance without breaking the user's flow.
